drivers: Three attributes (count, rotation, shape) must each be resolved; options are balanced to lure on each one independently
Count and rotation follow simple +1 / +45° progressions, visible in two rows and columns, which makes them easy to confirm
Shape/fill must be seen as a cyclic triad (striped pentagon → empty arrow → solid triangle) rather than a progression; triangle distractors exploit this
Verbal/schematic presentation and 105 s allow systematic checking, limiting time pressure
